title: SENIOR ARCHITECT SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER
description:
**WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING**
At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond.
**Together, we advance your career.**
**SENIOR ARCHITECT SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER**
**The Role**
AMD is looking for an influential software engineer who is passionate about improving the performance of key applications and benchmarks
**.**
You will be a member of a core team of incredibly talented industry specialists and will work with the very latest hardware and software technology.
  
  
**The Person**
The ideal candidate should be passionate about software engineering and possess leadership skills to drive sophisticated issues to resolution. Able to communicate effectively and work optimally with different teams across AMD.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the development and enhancements of the common automation framework for AMD SPSE team.
* Design and develop APIs for integration using either Java or Python language.
* Deploy application in containerized server infrastructure.
* Design and Development of web application and web services.
* Design and Manage Azure based cloud-based solutions.
* Design, develop, and support various Post Silicon Validation efforts.
* Maintaining and creating unit & integration tests for various applications.
* Work with AMD’s architecture specialists to improve future products
* Apply a data minded approach to target optimization efforts
* Stay informed of software and hardware trends and innovations, especially pertaining to algorithms and architecture
* Design and develop new groundbreaking AMD technologies
* Participating in new ASIC and hardware bring ups
* Debugging/fix existing issues and research alternative, more efficient ways to accomplish the same work
* Develop technical relationships with peers and partners

**Preferred Experience**

* Good knowledge of a high-level programming language like Python or Java.
* Experience with web service technology like REST, XML and JSON.
* Experience with continuous integration frameworks, preferably Jenkins.
* Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis abilities.
* Strong knowledge of data structures and algorithms.
* Strong knowledge of integration architectures, best practices, tools, techniques, and platforms.
* Familiarity with container technology such as docker is preferred.
* Familiarity with cloud-based solutions such as Azure is preferred.
* Understanding of software development process, build & test systems, automation tools is required.
* Strong Analytical capability and problem-solving skills with attention to details.
* Ability to guide and mentor junior member of the team.
* A willingness to take ownership of projects and drive them to completion.
* Ability to write high quality code with a keen attention to detail
* Experience with modern concurrent programming and threading APIs
* Experience with Windows, Linux and/or Android operating system development
* Experience with software development processes and tools such as debuggers, source code control systems (GitHub) and profilers is a plus
* Effective communication and problem-solving skills
* Motivating leader with good interpersonal skills

**Academic Credentials**

* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent

title: Mgr, Software Development,
description:
**This is where**
your work makes a difference.
  
  
At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.
  
  
Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.
  
  
Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a Development and Test Manager with 12+ years of experience leading software development, verification, and quality engineering for connected healthcare and regulated medical software. The manager will provide technical and people leadership across the complete product lifecycle—from requirements, architecture, design, and implementation through functional, automation, performance, reliability, and release-readiness testing. This role owns delivery of cloud-native applications, REST and GraphQL APIs, user interfaces, microservices, medical-device integrations, and EMR/EHR workflows within agreed quality, schedule, and budget commitments. The role combines engineering leadership, development and test governance, technical direction, stakeholder management, design-control compliance, and audit-ready delivery.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Define and continuously improve the integrated software development and test strategy in alignment with product roadmaps, business priorities, regulatory commitments, architecture direction, and release plans.
* Lead software developers, automation engineers, performance engineers, and functional verification engineers; manage capacity, hiring, onboarding, objectives, coaching, technical development, succession planning, and delivery accountability.
* Plan and lead engineering assignments involving the evaluation, selection, and adaptation of software designs, technologies, development methods, test approaches, tools, and engineering practices.
* Provide technical direction from product conception through requirements, architecture, detailed design, implementation, integration, verification, release, and sustaining activities.
* Establish software engineering governance covering estimation, design and code reviews, coding standards, branching and configuration management, unit and component testing, static analysis, code coverage, technical debt, defect management, and quality metrics.
* Ensure software architecture and implementation meet requirements for maintainability, security, scalability, performance, reliability, interoperability, observability, and supportability.
* Own delivery of cloud-native applications, microservices, REST and GraphQL APIs, web user interfaces, integration services, and data processing capabilities using appropriate C#/.NET and related technologies.
* Establish test governance, risk-based planning, entry and exit criteria, requirements traceability, defect management, quality dashboards, and release-readiness assessments.
* Own the roadmap and governance for reusable C#-based REST API and UI automation frameworks, including coding standards, test-data management, parallel execution, logging, reporting, and environment configuration.
* Ensure unit, component, integration, smoke, regression, performance, scalability, reliability, security, and release-level testing is incorporated into CI/CD pipelines with appropriate automated quality gates.
* Guide design, development, integration, and verification of HL7 ADT, FHIR resources, clinical workflows, EMR/EHR interfaces, connected medical devices, real-time communications, notifications, and downstream clinical systems.
* Implement configuration and change management throughout the complete product lifecycle, including design, development, verification, release, and sustaining phases.
* Partner with product, clinical, systems, architecture, DevOps, cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, service, manufacturing, and external integration teams to resolve dependencies, technical issues, and product risks.
* Drive root-cause analysis by correlating application behavior, source code, automated and performance results, logs, API traces, network data, database records, queues, container metrics, and infrastructure telemetry.
* Incorporate field issues, customer feedback, post-market learnings, and production trends into product design improvements, corrective actions, regression coverage, reliability testing, and performance validation.
* Ensure compliance with the product development process, design controls, Quality System requirements, software lifecycle procedures, cybersecurity expectations, and applicable regulatory standards.
* Maintain audit-ready requirements, architecture and design records, code and review evidence, plans, test cases, objective evidence, reports, approvals, and traceability in approved tools such as Jira, Jama, source-control platforms, and validated test-management systems.
* Develop project plans, engineering milestones, resource strategies, budgets, and delivery forecasts; identify and mitigate issues that could affect quality, cost, scope, or schedule.
* Manage external development partners, contractors, vendors, and third-party service providers, including technical direction, deliverable acceptance, and performance monitoring.
* Communicate development progress, quality status, technical risks, mitigation plans, resource needs, architecture decisions, test findings, and go/no-go recommendations to program and leadership forums.

**What You'll Bring**

* 12–18 years of software engineering, software development, testing, verification, quality engineering, or performance engineering experience, including at least 5 years leading multidisciplinary technical teams in a regulated or safety-critical environment.
* B.E/B. Tech in Computer Science / Electronics & Communication / Electrical or related field
* Demonstrated experience managing the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, code review, unit testing, integration, verification, release, and sustaining engineering.
* Strong hands-on or technical leadership experience with C#/.NET, object-oriented design, design patterns, REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, web applications, and distributed systems.
* Demonstrated ownership of functional and automation test strategy for REST APIs, web user interfaces, integration workflows, and end-to-end regression using Playwright, Selenium, NUnit, xUnit, MSTest, or comparable technologies.
* Experience with software architecture and engineering practices such as clean architecture, secure coding, static analysis, code quality, code coverage, configuration management, branching strategies, dependency management, and technical-debt reduction.
* Experience validating distributed microservices, event-driven systems, JSON/XML, SQL/PostgreSQL, authentication, authorization, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, MQTT, or comparable technologies.
* Working knowledge of Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, autoscaling, service discovery, role-based access control, secrets management, service mesh, resilience, and cloud observability.
* Experience with CI/CD architecture, Git, build automation, automated quality gates, pipeline troubleshooting, artifact management, deployment practices, test reporting, and engineering dashboards.
* Healthcare domain expertise covering HL7 v2, ADT messages and acknowledgements, FHIR REST resources, EMR/EHR workflows, connected medical devices, data integrity, patient safety, privacy, and clinical risk.
* Knowledge of regulated healthcare software practices and standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, design controls, cybersecurity expectations, and formal verification evidence.
* Ability to manage complex projects and engineering programs within boundaries of quality, time, scope, and budget while balancing development and verification priorities.
* Strong people leadership, stakeholder influencing, conflict resolution, planning, prioritization, vendor coordination, risk management, and executive communication skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with SIP, RTP, WebSocket, WebRTC, audio/video communication, Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, or comparable real-time communication technologies.
* Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Application Insights, APM platforms, centralized logging, packet analysis, database diagnostics, and automated performance-threshold evaluation.
* Knowledge of Azure Key Vault, Azure App Configuration, Redis, Web PubSub, Terraform, KEDA, infrastructure-as-code, service virtualization, and container security.
* Experience supporting regulatory audits, formal submissions, post-market investigations, and enterprise-scale healthcare product releases.
* Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, risk management, cybersecurity expectations, and quality systems for regulated healthcare software.
* Experience with Jira, Jama, validated toolchains, Agile/Scrum delivery, and formal release-readiness reviews.
* C#, Azure, Kubernetes, performance testing, healthcare interoperability, PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification is advantageous.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Software Application Engineer II (Oracle EBS)
description:
It takes powerful technology to connect our brands and partners with an audience of hundreds of millions of people. Whether you’re looking to write mobile app code, engineer the servers behind our massive ad tech stacks, or develop algorithms to help us process trillions of data points a day, what you do here will have a huge impact on our business—and the world.
  
  
**A Little About Us**
Yahoo delivers delightful, inspiring, and entertaining daily-habit experiences to over half a billion people worldwide. Our products include the Yahoo Homepage, Finance, Sports, and News. Yahoo in three words: Inform, connect, and entertain.
  
  
The Enterprise Application team is responsible for managing Yahoo's core financial systems alongside custom home-grown applications that support our global finance teams. We build and maintain high-velocity applications using Oracle R12, a combination of open-source software, and internal continuous integration tools like Screwdriver. We encourage new ideas, actively experiment with emerging technologies, and cultivate a team structure built on mutual trust, continuous learning, and shared technical growth.
  
  
**About You**
You are a proactive self-starter and problem solver who is committed to operational velocity, developer productivity, and overall product quality. You are an analytical troubleshooter who can prioritize and resolve complex technical challenges across varying timelines. You are self-driven, focused on understanding system mechanics deeply, and consistently look for ways to automate workflows at scale. You are comfortable working in an evolving, modern engineering landscape and look to incorporate advanced tools and methodologies to maximize your impact.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain Oracle EBS R12 customizations, extensions, interfaces, and integrations with upstream systems and reporting platforms.
* Partner with EBS functional specialists and business stakeholders to translate functional requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Perform performance tuning, troubleshooting, and code optimization while ensuring compliance with security and coding standards.
* Own end-to-end delivery of software features in an Agile, globally distributed team environment.
* Conduct code reviews, share technical knowledge, and mentor junior team members on Oracle R12 best practices.
* Leverage AI development tools to accelerate Oracle R12 development, SQL/PLSQL coding, testing, and performance optimization.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent experience.
* 5-8 years of Oracle EBS R12 and Oracle Cloud application development experience.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test - Database Automation
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
  
  
**About Us**
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
  
  
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
  
  
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
  
  
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
  
  
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
  
  
**About The Role**
Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.
  
  
We’re looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test with extensive industry experience to define and execute the design, development, and maintenance of Fivetran’s test automation tools and framework using reliable and scalable techniques.
  
  
As a Senior SDET, you will focus on solving complex testing difficulties by designing, developing and improving automation and reporting frameworks. You will invest in improving test stability and performance of the framework by developing innovative solutions to boost Fivetran’s testing efficiency. You will also coach Fivetran quality engineers to be the best in class automation engineers, and will continuously work with the team to ensure high standards for automation. The ideal candidate will be highly technical, detail-oriented, creative, motivated, and focused on achieving results.
  
  
In addition, this role emphasizes leveraging AI driven solutions to accelerate testing, enhance developer productivity, and improve operational insights, making Fivetran’s quality practices smarter, faster, and more scalable.
  
  
This is a full-time position based out of our Bangalore office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.
  
  
**Technologies You’ll Use**

* Languages & Frameworks: Java (17+), JUnit, REST Assured, Shell scripting; Python
* Infrastructure & Tooling: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Bazel, Buildkite
* Cloud & Platform: AWS, GCP, Azure
* Observability & Monitoring: Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog
* CI/CD & Automation: Jenkins, CircleCI, GitHub Actions
* Data & Testing:ELT pipelines, test automation utilities, whitebox testing strategies
* Databases: SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres, SAP , Oracle, DB2 ertc)

**What You’ll Do**
  
  

* Review requirements, specifications and technical design documents to provide meaningful, risk-focused feedback.
* Design and evolve scalable automation frameworks in Java with a strong emphasis on reliability, performance, and data correctness.
* Write high-signal test strategies for complex features and automate them across multiple environments.
* Improve CI/CD pipelines by building robust validation layers that prevent silent failures and regressions.

+ Build internal tools and proof-of-concepts using AI/LLM technologies to:
+ Accelerate debugging and failure triaging
+ Generate high-quality test scenarios
+ Detect flaky patterns or regression risks
+ Improve log analysis and root-cause identification
+ Enhance developer and QA productivity

* Design AI-assisted workflows that integrate seamlessly into the existing automation and release pipelines.
* Experiment with and implement agent-based systems or LLM-powered tooling that streamline development and testing processes.
* Actively measure and improve engineering impact through reliability metrics, automation efficiency, and defect prevention signals.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to drive a culture of quality ownership and automation-first thinking.
* Collaborate with engineering and product leaders to align testing priorities and business objectives.

**Skills We’re Looking For**

* 6+ years of experience in the software industry with strong passion for quality, automation, and engineering excellence.
* Deep understanding of OOP principles and strong proficiency in Java.
* Expertise in designing scalable automation frameworks and identifying negative, edge, and high-risk scenarios.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems risks such as schema drift, idempotency failures, data inconsistencies, and race conditions.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with tools such as Jenkins, Buildkite.
* Experience working with backend automation frameworks.
* Testing data pipeline or ELT platforms, with hands-on exposure to Change Data Capture (CDC) mechanisms, connector-based data ingestion, and validating data accuracy and consistency across source and destination systems at scale.
* Deep understanding of database internals
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI/LLM tools to significantly accelerate development, debugging, test design or automation activities.
* Experience building AI-assisted tools, workflows, or agents that integrate into engineering pipelines.

**Bonus Skills**

* Experience testing against cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) or CDC source databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
* Familiarity with log-based CDC mechanisms (binlog, WAL, ) and handling schema drift or evolution scenarios.
* Exposure to distributed systems testing, large-scale data reconciliation, and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) on cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure).
* Familiarity with data extraction using API-based polling, batch/file ingestion, and query-based incremental syncs.

**Perks And Benefits**
100% employer-paid medical insurance- Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.

title: Lead QA
description:
**Description**
**Team Leadership & Practice Development**
Lead, coach, and develop a team of QA practitioners embedded across delivery teams, ensuring consistent application of QA standards, methodologies, and tools.
  
  
Facilitate individual growth conversations, set development goals, and provide ongoing feedback and mentorship across the team.
  
  
Drive a culture of quality ownership, continuous improvement, and shared accountability.
  
  
Onboard new QA team members; establish expectations, tools access, and delivery team integration from day one.
  
  
Build team capacity by identifying skill gaps and supporting professional development plans aligned to the QA leveling framework.
  
  
Partner with US-based QA Practice Leads to align standards, share tooling and methodology advances, and build a globally consistent QA capability that scales across the enterprise.
  
  
**Test Strategy & Delivery Oversight**
Review and advise on test plans, automation coverage, and quality approaches across delivery squads to ensure alignment, completeness, and risk-based prioritization.
  
  
Own overall quality posture across programs — escalate systemic risks, monitor defect trends, and drive corrective action when patterns emerge.
  
  
Ensure QA is engaged at the start of every initiative, upgrade, and release planning conversation — not informed after delivery is underway.
  
  
Facilitate cross-role test planning sessions; ensure acceptance criteria are testable, risk-informed, and linked to Jira Xray test cases before development begins.
  
  
Champion shift-left practices across teams: proactive defect prevention through early requirements engagement, Behavior Driven Development, and risk surfacing during refinement.
  
  
**Automation & Tooling**
Guide delivery teams on scalable automation practices using the enterprise test automation framework (e.g. Playwright, Opkey).
  
  
Monitor automation coverage across teams; ensure automation is planned at project kickoff, not retrofitted at release.
  
  
Drive adoption of AI-assisted test creation approaches; track efficiency gains and share learnings with the broader QA practice.
  
  
Partner with development leads and DevOps to integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and production health monitoring.
  
  
**Agile & Delivery Integration**
Coach QA team members on integrating quality into Agile delivery — sprint planning, refinement, daily standups, and retrospectives.
  
  
Resolve testing-related delivery blockers across the QA team; align teams to program cadence and sprint-level quality goals.
  
  
Ensure QA practitioners are included as full members of delivery teams — not downstream recipients of completed work.
  
  
Partner with Agile Practices leads to embed QA excellence into delivery team agreements and working norms.
  
  
**Stakeholder Communication & Reporting**
Share quality health reports with development leads, delivery leads, and practice managers on a regular cadence.
  
  
Communicate test readiness and quality risk clearly to program stakeholders before major release decisions.
  
  
Represent the QA practice in cross-functional forums; translate QA data into business impact language for non-technical audiences.
  
  
Contribute to QA practice visibility through participation knowledge sharing, community of practice events, and internal showcases.
  
  
**Practice & Operations**
Ensure QA work is tracked and visible in Jira — test plans, execution status, defect metrics, and automation coverage — for all active programs.
  
  
Contribute to the ongoing maturation of QA standards, tooling, and playbooks.
  
  
Partner on capacity planning, staffing needs, and resource allocation across programs.
  
  
Support pursuit efforts by articulating QA value, methodology, and quality outcomes when needed.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  
  
12-14 years of QA testing experience, including demonstrated leadership of QA practitioners or delivery team QA coordination.
  
  
Strong command of software QA methodologies — functional, regression, integration, exploratory, UAT support, and performance testing.
  
  
Hands-on experience writing and maintaining test automation scripts; familiarity with frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress.
  
  
Experience with ERP or enterprise application testing (e.g., Oracle EBS, Unanet, EcoSys) is strongly preferred.
  
  
Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., JavaScript, Python, Java).
  
  
Experience with Xray, Jira, or Azure DevOps for test management and defect tracking.
  
  
Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines; familiarity with observability and production monitoring tools (e.g., New Relic, Dynatrace).
  
  
Demonstrated ability to communicate quality risk and testing outcomes clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
Strong coaching and mentoring instincts — able to develop practitioners at different experience levels.
  
  
Deep familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery practices and the QA's role within a cross-functional delivery team.
  
  
Relevant certifications (e.g., ISTQB) are advantageous.

title: Senior System Verification Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
At Ericsson, we are the world leader in 5G innovation and deployment, powering a connected future where technology improves the way we live and work. With unmatched expertise and market penetration in 5G New Radio (NR), we are shaping the future of communication and pioneering advancements that will lead us into the era of 6G.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**
Reliability earns trust. As part of our RAN System Verification team, you will work in advanced lab environments to verify, troubleshoot, and deliver Ericsson’s 5G New Radio (NR) solutions on high‑performance General Purpose Processors (GPP), with sharp focus on performance, scalability and quality. You will validate system behaviour under high‑load traffic scenarios, ensure that capacity and performance targets are met, and influence release decisions across our global product portfolio.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Provide technical leadership for end-to-end system verification of 5G features, shaping verification priorities from feature readiness to release in alignment with business strategy and customer outcomes
* Act as a technical specialist in system performance analysis using logs, traces, and KPIs such as throughput, latency, resource utilization, and QoS/QoE indicators to identify systemic bottlenecks and drive product-level improvements.
* Lead complex, cross-layer investigations across PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, and IP, applying advanced root-cause analysis to resolve complex performance and capacity issues.
* Perform requirement analysis for feature integration and verification to ensure alignment with customer expectations and network performance objectives.
* Perform capacity and performance verification of RAN systems under high-load traffic scenarios comprising Max supported UEs per cell/DU, throughput (DL/UL), control plane capacity and mobility under load.
* Establish verification methodologies and quality standards that represent live network scenarios and provide coverage for performance, capacity, Stability and customer experience.
* Provide technical direction, coaching, and mentorship to verification engineers and contribute to the development of organizational competence in modern (AI) system verification practices.
* Drive continuous improvement of products, verification frameworks, test coverage, automation, CI/CD pipelines, and AI-assisted verification practices, improving efficiency, quality, and time to market.
* Lead collaboration across RAN development, integration/CI, product management and other stakeholders organization to resolve issues and secure high-quality deliveries.
* Lead customer trials and field issue reproduction, move quickly from symptoms to root cause and provide clear defect reports with actionable next steps.

**The Skills You Bring**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
* 8 - 12+ years of hands‑on experience in system-level verification, deployment, integration, and troubleshooting of LTE/5G NR baseband and radio systems, including demonstrated technical leadership.
* Strong understanding of wireless communication systems (LTE/5G NR), RAN architecture and protocol stack, and 5G NR air‑interface technologies.
* Demonstrated experience analyzing and troubleshooting performance issues at PHY/MAC layer, including link curve verification, channel-quality assessment, and evaluation under diverse and adverse channel conditions.
* Deep expertise of system level KPIs (throughput, latency, resource load, QoS/QoE) and the ability to identify performance bottlenecks.
* Experience working with Channel emulators, fading technologies, traffic generation and test tools (for example UE simulators, Viavi, real UEs).
* Advanced Linux skills and solid knowledge of IP routing, switching, and networking.
* Demonstrated success in influencing product, architecture, and release decisions through data-driven verification insights and technical judgment.
* Programming, automation, and scripting skills (for example Python, Bash, Java) and solid understanding of CI/CD concepts.
* Experience with configuration management and automation tools (for example Git, Gerrit, Jenkins) in a modern development and integration environment.
* Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills with a focus on verification improvements and innovation.
* Demonstrated customer focus, including experience supporting customer trials, reproducing field issues and assessing risk.

Nice to have:
  
  

* Exposure to Cloud-Native RAN, O-RAN Architecture.
* Experience with commercial UE chipset platform testing (Qualcomm, MediaTek etc) and end‑to‑end performance validation.
* Knowledge of cloud‑native principles, containerization, and microservices‑based architectures.
* Familiarity with AI/ML tooling for test analytics and anomaly detection.
* Software development skills, particularly in Java and Python.

Why Join Us:
  
  

* Work with global experts in a high-performing, innovative, and global engineering environment.
* Work on cutting-edge 5G technology and be at the forefront of 6G innovation.
* Contribute directly to the quality of live networks and customer experience worldwide.
* Build deep expertise in system-level performance, capacity and reliability engineering.
* Flexible work environment, career growth and a diverse, inclusive environment.

title: Support AI Manager
description:
**About Ethos**
Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Support AI Manager to lead the team that builds and safeguards the quality of our AI-powered support bots. This role owns two connected functions: the bot building team (led day-to-day by a build Lead who designs ERDs and manages hands-on development) and the bot monitoring team (with functions including bot functionality audits, bug handling, quality control, and support). You'll manage and scale both, while remaining hands-on enough to personally evaluate bot builds against spec and catch issues before they reach customers.
  
  
The what and how of the roadmap are owned by our CX AI Product Manager, who sets priorities and writes the PRDs. Your job is to make sure what gets built actually matches that spec, to define how we test and monitor bots on an ongoing basis, and to make sure quality issues make it back into the roadmap fast. This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a purely administrative one — you should be comfortable reviewing a build yourself, not just hearing about it secondhand.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Manage and grow the bot building team and the bot quality/monitoring team, including coaching the build Lead as they grow into managing a focused, subject matter expert team of builders.
* Personally review bot builds and version deploys against approved ERDs and PRDs, catching spec drift, gaps, or quality issues before launch.
* Define and own the testing cadence for the team — pre-launch UAT, regression testing, and frequency and scope of live bot audits.
* Own the feedback loop between quality/monitoring findings and the roadmap, making sure issues surfaced by your team get back to the Product Manager and build Lead quickly and are prioritized appropriately.
* Consolidate all feedback into a clear, structured format, ensuring all items are accurately tracked and escalated where appropriate.
* Serve as the primary escalation point when a build doesn't match spec or a quality issue is found, working directly with the build and quality teams to resolve it.
* Partner closely with the CX AI Product Manager to keep the build and quality functions aligned with roadmap priorities and sequencing.
* Use bot performance metrics (deflection rate, true resolution rate, CSAT, error rates) to spot systemic quality issues and drive process improvements across build and monitoring.
* Build and evolve the team's testing/monitoring playbook as the bot portfolio grows.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* 4+ years of experience managing a team, ideally across more than one function or workstream.
* Hands-on experience with the design, build, or QA of AI-driven voice, chat or email bots — enough technical depth to personally evaluate a build against an ERD or PRD.
* Experience working within a product pod or similar cross-functional product team structure, partnering closely with a product manager.
* Strong process orientation — comfortable defining and owning a testing and monitoring cadence from scratch, not just following an existing one.
* Detail-oriented, with strong problem-solving instincts and a track record of leading a team through issue resolution.
* Excellent communicator, able to translate technical build or quality issues for both technical teams and product/business stakeholders.
* Experience with support bot platforms (e.g., Forethought, Ada, Sierra, Decagon) is a strong plus.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. title: Senior Firmware Engineer
description:
**Your Impact**
You will be working on sophisticated, industrial, real-time systems involving embedded firmware, Linux-based platforms, industrial communications, and critical monitoring applications. This team of engineers develops innovative monitoring systems used for Grid Monitoring, Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS), and Generation applications in electrical substations and power plants.
  
  
As a Senior Firmware Engineer, you will play a key role in the design, development, and support of embedded firmware for mission-critical monitoring and diagnostic products used throughout the electrical power industry. Working closely with Systems, Hardware, Test, and Product Management teams, you will develop software across bare-metal, RTOS-based, and embedded Linux environments, delivering solutions that meet demanding requirements for performance, reliability, cybersecurity, and maintainability. You will contribute across the complete product lifecycle, from requirements definition and architecture through implementation, integration, verification, release, and sustaining engineering. Leveraging modern software engineering practices, including AI-assisted development, code analysis, debugging, and test automation tools where appropriate, you will help accelerate delivery while maintaining the high standards of quality, safety, and reliability expected of products deployed throughout the world's power generation, transmission, and distribution infrastructure.
  
  
****Here's Where You'll Demonstrate Your Proficiencies:****

* Design, develop, maintain, and debug embedded firmware for real-time monitoring and diagnostic systems spanning bare-metal, RTOS-based, and embedded Linux platforms.
* Develop high-quality software solutions using Embedded C/C++ on microcontroller and microprocessor-based systems.
* Develop low-level firmware, Board Support Packages (BSPs), device drivers, bootloaders, and hardware abstraction layers for embedded products.
* Collaborate with Systems, Hardware, Software, and Test Engineers to deliver integrated product solutions.
* Implement and maintain communications interfaces and industrial protocols including IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus, IEC 60870, and related technologies.
* Develop software for data acquisition, event processing, diagnostics, communications, and system control functions.
* Support firmware integration activities across embedded Linux, Windows, and real-time operating environments.
* Perform root-cause analysis, troubleshooting, and performance optimisation of complex embedded systems.
* Develop and execute unit, integration, and system-level testing to ensure product quality and reliability.
* Support software configuration management, traceability, and product release activities.
* Contribute to compliance, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements throughout the product lifecycle.
* Utilise modern AI-assisted development, code review, debugging, and test generation tools to improve engineering productivity and software quality.
* Champion continuous improvement of software development processes through automation, AI-enabled engineering practices, and data-driven decision making.
* Support adoption of modern development practices including automated testing, static analysis, CI/CD, and AI-assisted software lifecycle workflows.
* Work within Agile Scrum teams to support efficient product delivery and continuous innovation.

****Qualifications****
The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the following skills and experience:
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum five years of industry experience in embedded firmware development, testing, debugging, and deployment.
* Strong experience developing firmware for microcontroller and microprocessor-based systems, including bare-metal and RTOS-based applications.
* Expert-level proficiency in Embedded C/C++ development within real-time and multi-threaded environments.
* Strong understanding of embedded software design principles, software architecture, interrupt-driven systems, memory management, and real-time operating systems.
* Experience developing software for peripheral interfaces including UART, SPI, I²C, CAN, Ethernet, USB, and related technologies.
* Experience with low-level hardware interfaces, board bring-up, embedded debugging, and hardware-software integration.
* Proven experience developing and supporting industrial communication protocols including IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus, IEC 60870, or similar.
* Experience working with embedded Linux environments, device drivers, and system-level software components.
* Experience using source control systems such as Git and modern software development workflows.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, interpersonal, and technical communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a cross-functional engineering team.

****Preferred Skills****

* Experience developing products for the electrical power, utility, industrial automation, or critical infrastructure sectors.
* Experience with Digital Fault Recording (DFR), Power Quality (PQ), PMU, GIS monitoring, transformer monitoring, partial discharge monitoring, or related applications.
* Experience with bare-metal firmware development on ARM Cortex-M or similar embedded architectures.
* Experience with RTOS environments such as FreeRTOS, ThreadX, Zephyr, or similar real-time operating systems.
* Experience developing Board Support Packages (BSPs), bootloaders, device drivers, and low-level platform software.
* Experience with Ethernet networking, protocol analysers, managed switches, PTP, NTP, or time-synchronised systems.
* Experience troubleshooting communications using packet capture and analysis tools such as Wireshark.
* Familiarity with JTAG, SWD, in-circuit debuggers, logic analysers, and embedded software diagnostic tools.
* Knowledge of microcontroller peripherals including DMA, timers, ADCs, DACs, watchdogs, interrupt controllers, and clock management systems.
* Knowledge of software verification, automated testing, and unit testing frameworks.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated build systems, and software quality tools.
* Understanding of cybersecurity principles, secure communications, authentication mechanisms, and secure firmware development practices.
* Experience with FPGA integration or FPGA-based embedded systems.
* Experience leveraging AI-assisted software development tools and Large Language Model (LLM) technologies to improve software development, testing, documentation, and engineering efficiency.
* Experience with Python or other scripting languages for automation and test development.
* Exposure to C#, JavaScript, or other software development languages would be advantageous.
* Experience using engineering collaboration tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
* Familiarity with Agile Scrum methodologies.

****About Ralliant****
Ralliant stands as a bold, independent public company driving innovation at the forefront of precision technology. With a global footprint and a legacy of excellence, we empower engineers to bring next-generation breakthroughs to life—faster, smarter, and more reliably.
  
  
Our high-performance instruments, sensors, and subsystems fuel mission-critical advancements across industries, enabling real-world impact where it matters most. From power generation and transmission to industrial automation and critical infrastructure, our technologies help customers monitor, protect, and optimise their most valuable assets.

title: Hardware Engineer, Infrastructure Silicon Validation
description:
Meta's Infrastructure Silicon team designs and deploys custom silicon solutions that power the compute, networking, and storage infrastructure underpinning Meta's data centers at global scale. As a Hardware Engineer focused on Infrastructure Silicon Validation, you will be responsible for validating custom ASICs and silicon platforms — including compute accelerators, network ASICs, and storage controllers — ensuring they meet functional, performance, and reliability requirements before and after deployment. In this role, you will develop and execute validation strategies, build test infrastructure, and work closely with silicon design, firmware, and data center operations teams to bring next-generation infrastructure silicon from tape-out through production qualification.
  
  
Hardware Engineer, Infrastructure Silicon Validation Responsibilities:
  
  

* Develop and execute comprehensive validation plans for custom infrastructure ASICs, including compute accelerators, network ASICs, and storage controllers, covering functional correctness, performance, and reliability
* Design and implement hardware validation frameworks, test benches, and automated test suites to characterize silicon behavior across operating conditions
* Perform bring-up and debug of custom silicon platforms, identifying and root-causing functional failures, timing violations, and signal integrity issues
* Collaborate with RTL design and physical design teams to translate design intent into silicon-level validation coverage plans and corner-case test scenarios
* Partner with firmware and software teams to validate hardware-software interfaces, including register maps, interrupt handling, DMA engines, and PCIe/Ethernet protocol stacks
* Analyze silicon characterization data to assess performance margins, power consumption, and thermal behavior, providing actionable feedback to design teams
* Drive post-silicon debug using lab instrumentation such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, and JTAG-based debug tools
* Define and track silicon validation milestones, communicate risk and status to cross-functional stakeholders, and drive resolution of blocking issues
* Contribute to the development of scalable validation infrastructure and methodologies that can be reused across multiple silicon programs
* Support production qualification and yield analysis by working with manufacturing and data center operations teams to characterize silicon at volume

Minimum Qualifications:
  
  

* 6+ years of experience in post-silicon validation, hardware bring-up, or silicon characterization of custom ASICs or SoCs
* Experience developing and executing validation plans for complex digital hardware, including functional verification, performance characterization, and reliability testing
* Experience debugging hardware failures using lab instrumentation such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG debuggers, and protocol analyzers
* Experience with scripting or programming languages (e.g., Python, C, or C++) for test automation, data analysis, or hardware control
* Experience collaborating with RTL design, physical design, and firmware teams to drive silicon bring-up and issue resolution

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Understanding of embedded systems, including common bus protocols such as I2C, SPI, USB, and/or PCIe
* Experience with some of the following modules/domains: PCIe, Networking, Ethernet, Flash, Memory, CPU, GPU, DRAM (LP/DDR4/5 and/or HBM). Experience with application, host driver development etc is a plus
* Experience working with Emulation/FPGA platforms for test content development, debug, and enablement on post-silicon
* Experience with Linux systems and server systems management
* Experience validating data center infrastructure, such as compute accelerators, network ASICs, or storage controllers in a hyperscale or cloud environment

About Meta:
  
  
Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
description:
**Role Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
We are looking for a hands-on Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our AI-native product development team at onsemi and own end-to-end quality and release certification for a full-stack platform built on Next.js, React, TypeScript, Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, GraphQL, Airflow, MCP-based AI agents, Kubernetes, Helm, and Docker. This is a full-stack testing role covering UI, API, data, async job, and AI-agent layers, with accountability for certifying that each release meets functional, non-functional, and reliability bars before reaching production. The candidate should build durable automation frameworks and make heavy, responsible use of AI coding agents to design test strategy, generate and maintain suites, and triage failures faster.
  
  
**Success Expectations**
You should independently own end-to-end quality for the platform: building and maintaining a full-stack automated test pyramid (unit, API, integration, E2E, non-functional, and AI-agent evaluation), certifying releases against clear, evidence-based exit criteria, using AI coding agents responsibly to accelerate test authoring and triage, and partnering with engineering to continuously reduce defect escape rate without slowing delivery.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own test strategy and automation across the stack: unit/component tests (Vitest, React Testing Library), API/integration tests (pytest, pytest-django, GraphQL), and UI-driven end-to-end tests (Playwright) against real workflows.
* Own release certification: define exit criteria, run and triage full regression suites (including sequential, long-running workflow integration tests), and give a clear go/no-go signal per release.
* Maintain functional coverage for core workflows: project/variant management, GDS and model linking, test bench execution, regression dispatch and reporting, compliance/RTM tracking, sharing/permissions, and notifications.
* Build test coverage for the AI Agent Workspace: prompt/response evaluation harnesses, tool-call correctness, contract tests for MCP-based agent tool servers, RAG pipeline retrieval/grounding accuracy, agent memory and session-persistence correctness, agent regression/eval suites, and guardrails against unsafe agent actions.
* Design and execute non-functional testing: API/GraphQL performance and load testing, resilience/failure-injection testing for async job pipelines, and baseline security testing (authN/authZ, RBAC, input validation).
* Validate the decoupled async execution model end-to-end — Airflow-orchestrated job dispatch, the containerized GDS/layout processing engine, and the Windows-hosted execution runner that drives external EDA tool runs — through result ingestion, including monitoring for stuck or failed jobs.
* Own visual and functional parity testing between the design prototype and the production frontend.
* Integrate and maintain automated quality gates in CI/CD, including flake detection, test data seeding/cleanup, and environment readiness checks.
* Use AI coding agents daily to generate/maintain tests, analyze failures, and turn bug reports into reproducible automated tests — validating AI output rather than accepting it blindly.
* Practice spec-driven testing: convert specs and acceptance criteria into test plans, traceable cases, and regression checklists; track quality metrics and report release readiness to stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* 3 to 5 years in software quality engineering, test automation, or SDET roles, with demonstrable ownership of release certification for a production system.
* Strong hands-on experience with Playwright (or equivalent) for UI-driven end-to-end testing of React/Next.js apps, including async state and long-running workflows.
* Strong hands-on experience with API/backend test automation (pytest, pytest-django, or equivalent), including REST and GraphQL testing.
* Working knowledge of component/unit testing with Vitest, Jest, or React Testing Library.
* Solid understanding of relational databases, test data management, and seeding/cleanup for repeatable automated runs.
* Experience testing asynchronous, job-queue-based, or event-driven systems (Redis, background workers, Airflow or similar orchestration pipelines).
* Experience designing non-functional test strategies: performance/load, resilience/chaos testing, and baseline security testing.
* Practical experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm, and CI/CD pipelines as quality gates.
* Strong, demonstrable experience using AI coding agents (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to generate and maintain test automation, with the judgment to validate AI-generated tests.
* Understanding of AI-agent/LLM application testing: prompt/response evaluation, tool-call verification, and agentic regression/guardrail testing.
* Excellent defect triage and cross-functional communication skills; ability to make an independent, defensible release go/no-go call.

title: Senior Technical Lead
description:
Location: Bangalore, India
  
  
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
  
  
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. **Role Overview**
We are seeking a senior Technical Leader with deep expertise in real-time embedded application development to mentor, guide, and build high-performing engineering teams for safety-critical applications. The role combines hands-on technical leadership, certification ownership, and team capability building aligned with DO-178C.

* Act as a mentor for DO-178C and real-time embedded development across projects.

+ DO-178C compliance mindset
+ Real-time embedded design principles
+ High-quality coding, verification, and documentation practices

* Lead technical reviews, design walkthroughs, and certification readiness sessions.

* Act as key technical interface during certification audits and authority interactions.
* Identify certification risks early and drive mitigation plans.

**Real-Time Embedded Software Development**

+ Embedded Linux applications with real-time constraints

* Review and approve software architecture, design, and implementation for safety and real-time correctness.
* Collaborate with system and hardware teams for end-to-end integration.

**Verification, Quality & Process**

* Lead verification and validation (V&V) strategy and execution.
* Ensure compliance with:

+ Requirements-based testing
+ Structural coverage (Statement, Decision, MC/DC)
+ Verification independence

* Guide teams on tool qualification (DO-330) and verification automation.

**Mandatory Skills & Qualifications**
**Leadership & Mentoring**

* Proven experience in mentoring, coaching, and leading embedded software teams.
* Demonstrated ability to build teams from scratch or scale existing teams.
* Experience defining technical standards, review mechanisms, and skill-development plans.

**DO-178C & Certification**

* Strong hands-on experience with DO-178C, preferably DAL A or DAL B.
* Deep expertise in:

+ Requirements-based development
+ Traceability and lifecycle compliance
+ Certification audits and authority interactions

* Experience with DO-178C supplements:

+ DO-330

**Embedded & Real-Time Development**

* Strong experience in real-time embedded application development.
* Hands-on expertise in:

+ Bare-metal programming
+ Embedded Linux or any RTOS

**Programming & Tools**

* Proficiency in C and C++
* Experience with:

+ Cross-compilers, GDB
+ Requirements tools (e.g. DOORS, Polarion)
+ Verification tools (e.g. RTRT)
+ Configuration management (Git)

**Experience & Education**

* 15+ years of experience in avionics or safety-critical embedded software.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in relevant engineering discipline.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. * Design and build large-scale distributed applications using serverless technologies, data lakes, and NoSQL databases to automate infrastructure supply chain processes for AWS.

You start your morning reviewing deployment metrics and triaging any operational alerts. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. title: Principal Debug Validation Engineer
description:
**About Us**
Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute.
  
  
It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.
  
  
As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.
  
  
Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore enjoys a culture of continuous learning and constant innovation.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Reporting to senior leadership within Architecture and Validation, the Debug Validation Lead will drive post-silicon debug and validation activities for next-generation AI compute silicon and systems. The role is responsible for leading teams focused on identifying, reproducing, analysing and resolving complex silicon, firmware and system-level issues during bring-up, characterization and product readiness.
  
  
This position combines deep technical debugging expertise with strong cross-functional collaboration across multiple engineering disciplines. The role will work closely with architecture, RTL, firmware, software and systems teams to improve debug methodologies, accelerate issue resolution and strengthen validation coverage. The role will work closely with architecture, RTL, firmware, software, systems and platform teams to improve debug methodologies, accelerate issue resolution and strengthen validation coverage.
  
  
The Team
  
  
The Post-Silicon Debug and Validation team sits within the Architecture and Validation organisation and is responsible for bring-up, debug and validation of Graphcore silicon and systems.
  
  
The team works across the full product lifecycle, supporting first silicon bring-up, subsystem validation, system integration and production readiness activities. Engineers collaborate closely with hardware, firmware, software and systems teams to investigate complex failures, develop debug methodologies and improve validation infrastructure.
  
  
Responsibilities and Duties
  
  

* Lead post-silicon debug and validation activities for AI compute silicon and platform technologies
* Contribute to debug and validation activities across multiple projects and milestones
* Drive prioritisation, planning and execution of debug and validation activities across multiple projects and milestones
* Investigate and resolve complex silicon, firmware, software and system-level issues during bring-up and validation
* Develop structured debug methodologies and failure analysis processes to improve issue resolution efficiency
* Collaborate closely with architecture, RTL, firmware, software and systems engineering teams to identify root causes and implement corrective actions
* Drive debug of CPU, memory, interconnect and high-speed I/O subsystems under functional, stress and workload conditions
* Develop and enhance automated debug, regression and validation infrastructure using Python and related technologies
* Analyse logs, traces, telemetry and hardware data to isolate and characterize system failures and performance issues
* Support development of validation tests, debug tooling and custom diagnostics to improve coverage and observability
* Define validation metrics, debug workflows and reporting standards to ensure consistent and repeatable analysis
* Drive continuous improvement of debug processes, validation methodologies and engineering workflows
* Communicate technical risks, status and recommendations clearly to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
* Support silicon readiness reviews and contribute to product quality and release decisions
* Contribute to continuous improvement of debug methodologies, validation infrastructure and engineering workflows

Candidate Profile
  
  
**Essential**

* Strong experience in bare metal environments
* Good knowledge of SoC and platform architectures
* Expertise in debug infrastructure and post-silicon debug methodologies
* Strong programming skills in Python, C, or debug scripting languages such as CMM
* Highly motivated self-starter with a collaborative and team-oriented approach
* Ability to work across teams and programming languages to identify root causes of deep and complex issues
* Experience of the post-silicon validation process applied in digital ASIC environments
* Strong Linux and Python experience
* Exceptional communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively to solve complex problems
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical and diagnostic skills
* Deep knowledge of scan, DFT, JTAG and trace infrastructure
* Strong debug skills including fault tree analysis, failure isolation, fishbone methodologies and system-level debug techniques
* Ability to work independently on technically complex debug and validation activities across hardware, firmware and software domains

Desirable
  
  

* Understanding of DFT flows from insertion through post-silicon validation
* Experience developing tooling for parsing and analysing debug data, including scan dump parsing
* Driver-level experience with one or more of the following technologies:

+ PCIe
+ Ethernet
+ Memory technologies including LPDDR, DDR and HBM
+ Peripheral interfaces such as I2C, I3C and SPI

* Experience using CoreSight and similar debug infrastructure including CTI, ETx, DStream, JLink, Lauterbach, ATB and STM
* Good knowledge of mixed-signal building blocks such as PLLs, high-speed PHYs and IC control/communication protocols
* Experience with Arm CPU architectures, system IP and associated debug tooling
* Experience with AMBA protocols
* Understanding of ML applications and associated workloads
* Experience in characterization, failure analysis, test development, statistical analysis and customer support

title: Staff Software Applications Engineer
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
  
  
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
  
  
**Role**
As a
**Staff Software Engineer, Finance Integrations**
within Zscaler’s IT organization (reporting to the Manager, Integrations), you will lead the design and delivery of scalable integration and automation solutions supporting Finance transformation. In this role, you will partner closely with Finance stakeholders to modernize processes, reduce spreadsheet dependencies, improve data flow across systems, and deliver intelligent automation using APIs, middleware, RPA, and AI technologies. You will act as a key technical driver working across cross-functional groups to deliver measurable business outcomes.

* Design, build, and maintain scalable enterprise integrations using APIs, middleware, event-driven architectures, and sound enterprise architecture principles

* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution
* You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact

**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
* 8+ years of experience in software engineering, integrations, or enterprise applications
* Strong finance systems background with hands-on experience supporting and modernizing finance business processes
* Deep expertise in APIs, middleware, event-driven architectures, and enterprise integration patterns
* Proven experience delivering AI, automation, or intelligent process transformation solutions
* Solid understanding of SOX, audit, cybersecurity awareness, and internal controls in an enterprise environment

* Hands-on experience with key systems such as NetSuite, Workday, FloQast, and Workiva
* Proven track record implementing integrations via Workato, UiPath, and MCP integrations

Talkdesk solution supports millions of real time interactions on a scalable data platform across Voice and Digital Channels, offers several NLP and AI capabilities and provides actionable insights to administrators, agents and supervisors.

Responsibilities

* **Quality Assurance & Strategy:**
  Design, build, execute, and maintain automated test suites and manual functional test cases for SaaS services hosted on AWS, ensuring product releases meet quality, performance, and five 9’s reliability standards.
* **Agile & CI/CD Environment:**

* **Workflow Management:**
  Manage day-to-day testing tasks, bug tracking, and test execution reporting using GitHub, Jira, and internal Talkdesk systems.
* **End-to-End Ownership:**
  Take end-to-end ownership of test coverage for microservices, validate safe deployment practices, and operate with a DevOps/Quality Engineering mindset.
* **Test Architecture & Non-Functional Testing:**
  Validate microservices against Security, Reliability, Performance, and Telemetry standards, actively flagging and mitigating technical debt in test coverage.
* **Automated & Functional Test Execution:**

* **Cross-Functional Alignment:**

* **Agile Participation:**

title: Lead I - Software Testing (Senior Servicenow QA, CMDB)
description:
**Role Description**
Job Description –
  
  
Senior QA ServiceNow Analyst Focus: CMDB, CSDM, ITOM and Enterprise Service Management Testing Role Summary The candidate should have a strong background in ServiceNow Quality Assurance and test engineering, with extensive experience in validating ServiceNow platform implementations across key modules and a demonstrated ability to design, execute, and govern testing for Configuration Management Database (CMDB) and Common Service Data Model (CSDM) capabilities.
  
  
The role requires deep knowledge of testing methodologies applied to ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, SecOps, SPM, Discovery, Service Mapping, integrations, and data governance. The Senior ServiceNow QA Analyst will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and data integrity of platform solutions that improve service visibility, configuration data quality, operational efficiency, and business-service alignment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, development, and execution of ServiceNow test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scripts covering functional, integration, regression, UAT, and end-to-end testing.
* Collaborate with business, infrastructure, security, and application stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into comprehensive test coverage and acceptance criteria.
* Perform testing across ServiceNow modules including ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, SecOps, SPM, Discovery, and Service Mapping. Own end-to-end validation of the CMDB implementation, including CI class design, identification and reconciliation rules, data sources, relationships, lifecycle states, normalization, and data certification outcomes.
* Validate CSDM adoption and data model integrity across foundation data, design, manage technical services, sell/consume, and service portfolio domains, in line with the organization's maturity and roadmap.
* Test and verify application services, business applications, technical services, service offerings, dynamic CI groups, and their relationships against CSDM guidance. Execute CMDB Health validation including completeness, correctness, compliance, duplicate management, orphan CI remediation, stale CI controls, and data-quality reporting.
* Validate CMDB data ingestion from ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping, cloud platforms, endpoint tools, asset systems, monitoring solutions, and third-party data sources.
* Design and execute test coverage for business rules, Script Includes, client scripts, UI policies, data policies, Flow Designer flows, IntegrationHub spokes, and other configuration elements. Validate Service Catalog items, workflows, approvals, notifications, and request-fulfilment processes.
* Test integrations built using REST, SOAP, MID Server, IntegrationHub, import sets, transform maps, and scripted APIs. Validate security controls, including ACLs, roles, data segregation, and secure integration practices through negative and role-based testing.
* Design and implement Automated Test Framework (ATF) suites for regression testing, upgrade readiness, and continuous validation. Monitor and report defects, root-cause analyses, quality metrics, and coverage dashboards; drive defect triage and closure with development teams.
* Provide QA leadership, test-case reviews, quality assurance for design deliverables, troubleshooting support, and mentorship to junior testers.
* Partner with process owners and platform governance teams to define CMDB/CSDM data-quality standards, ownership, stewardship, and continuous-improvement plans.
* Support release management activities including UAT coordination, upgrade testing, and post-deployment validation.
* Stay current with ServiceNow product releases, CMDB/CSDM guidance, testing best practices, and emerging capabilities.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow testing and quality assurance, including experience validating enterprise-scale implementations.
* Strong hands-on experience testing ServiceNow CMDB, including CI class modeling, relationships, Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE), reconciliation rules, data sources, transform maps, and CMDB Health validation.
* Practical experience validating CSDM implementations, including business applications, application services, technical services, service offerings, and supporting foundation data.
* Experience testing ServiceNow Discovery and/or Service Mapping outputs, including MID Server validation, credentials, patterns, discovery pattern debugging, and reconciliation of discovered data. In-depth understanding of CMDB governance, data ownership, lifecycle management, certification, normalization, duplicate remediation, and data-quality controls from a testing perspective.
* Strong proficiency in ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF), test-case design, defect management, and QA best practices.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript, Glide APIs, HTML, CSS, XML, and ServiceNow scripting sufficient to read, debug, and validate platform code.
* Extensive testing experience across at least three ServiceNow modules such as ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, GRC/IRM, SecOps, and SPM.
* Proven experience testing scoped or custom applications on the ServiceNow platform. Experience validating ServiceNow integrations using REST, SOAP, IntegrationHub, MID Server, and other APIs (API testing tools such as Postman, SoapUI).
* Solid understanding of ITIL practices, service management processes, asset management, infrastructure domains, and application-service dependencies.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex platform, integration, Discovery, and CMDB data issues.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA), or equivalent demonstrable platform expertise.

**Preferred Skills**

* ServiceNow CIS – Discovery, CIS – Service Mapping, CIS – ITSM, CIS – CSM, or other relevant implementation certifications.
* ISTQB (Foundation / Advanced) or equivalent QA certification.
* Hands-on experience with CSDM adoption assessments, maturity roadmaps, data-model remediation, and migration validation from legacy or custom service models.
* Experience validating Service Graph Connectors, Multisource CMDB, CMDB Data Manager, Data Certification, and IntegrationHub ETL.
* Knowledge of cloud and infrastructure platforms such as AWS, Azure, VMware, Kubernetes, network devices, databases, and enterprise applications for infrastructure test validation.
* Experience with test automation tools (Selenium, Cypress, Tosca) integrated with ServiceNow ATF. Experience with Agile / Scrum delivery methodologies, DevOps practices, CI/CD test integration, source control, and ServiceNow application deployment testing.
* Familiarity with defect-tracking and test-management tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, HP ALM, qTest, or Zephyr.
* Understanding of ITIL 4, service portfolio management, enterprise architecture, and application portfolio management concepts. Experience validating ServiceNow low-code/no-code capabilities, including Flow Designer, App Engine Studio, UI Builder, and Workspace configuration.
* Ability to facilitate technical workshops, walkthroughs, and defect triage sessions with architects, process owners, operations teams, and senior stakeholders.

**Skills**
ServiceNow, CMDB, Test Automation
