 We are looking for an experienced Software QA Engineer with strong expertise in test automation, API testing, and modern quality engineering practices to help ensure the reliability and quality of our software products.
   

  

 In this role, you will design and implement automated testing solutions across functional, regression, integration, API, and end\-to\-end scenarios. You will work closely with Product Management, Software Development, Quality Engineering, and other stakeholders to define effective test strategies and integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
   

  

 The role also provides an opportunity to work with AI\-agent\-driven workflows, LLM\-based applications, knowledge graph technologies, and modern test automation approaches.

* Test AI and agentic workflows: Develop testing approaches for AI\-agent\-driven workflows and LLM\-based applications, evaluating functional behavior, workflow reliability, accuracy, and expected outcomes.

* Strong understanding of software testing methodologies such as Agile, Scrum, TDD, BDD, along with excellent analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

* Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP.

* Familiarity with security testing practices, including DAST and penetration testing concepts.
* Experience testing browser\-based applications across functionality, performance, and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Experience with Data Science, Data Visualization, Data Analytics, RDF, or Knowledge Graph technologies.

description:
**Our Mission**
**SPAN is enabling electrification for all ⚡**
 We are a mission\-driven company designing, building, and deploying products that electrify the built environment, reduce carbon emissions, and slow the effects of climate change.
   

  

* Decarbonization is the process to reduce or remove greenhouse gas emissions, especially carbon dioxide, from entering our atmosphere.
* Electrification is the process of replacing fossil fuel appliances that run on gas or oil with all\-electric upgrades for a cleaner way to power our lives.


**At SPAN, We Believe In**
* Enabling homes and vehicles powered by clean energy
* Making electrification upgrades possible
* Building more resilient homes with reliable backup
* Designing a flexible and distributed electrical grid


**The Role**
 Test Architect (Energy Systems \& Grid Integration)
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 The Test Architect is a senior individual contributor who defines and owns the end\-to\-end validation strategy for SPAN's intelligent energy products — spanning hardware, firmware, cloud, and mobile. This role requires deep expertise in power/energy systems testing, HIL/HITL architecture, CI/CD integration, and cross\-functional collaboration across India and US teams. The hire will directly raise release confidence, reduce field defects, and scale SPAN's global quality infrastructure.
   

  

**Step 1\. Job Description**
 As a Test Architect at SPAN, you will define and drive the end\-to\-end test strategy and architecture for SPAN's intelligent energy systems — including SPAN Panels, SPAN Drive, battery integrations, EV charging, and grid interactions. You will ensure system reliability, safety, and scalability across hardware, firmware, cloud, and mobile applications.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Define end\-to\-end validation strategy across SPAN Panel (Gen2/Gen3\), SPAN Drive, battery systems (e.g., Powerwall, Franklin), and grid/load interactions.
* Build system\-level test architecture covering App ↔ Cloud ↔ Hardware ↔ Grid; mix manual, automation, HIL/SIL.
* Apply risk\-based testing for safety\-critical power systems; ensure coverage for corner cases and failure modes.
* Lead validation of energy flows, outages, failover, backup scenarios, interoperability with inverters, batteries, and EVSEs.
* Partner closely with teams on third\-party integrations to validate end\-to\-end behaviours.
* Architect scalable HIL/HIL environments with simulators and emulators.
* Standardize lab procedures and fixtures; ensure India and US labs are aligned and interchangeable.
* Integrate suites into CI/CD (Buildkite, Jenkins, GitHub Actions); enforce quality gates and build health signals.
* Define and track coverage (feature/system/integration), defect leakage/escape rate, pass rate, MTTR, and MTTD.
* Standardize dashboards in JIRA, TestRail; ensure traceability requirements → test cases → defects.
* Collaborate with Product, Firmware, Software, and DevOps to align on release risk and validation scope.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
 Core Expertise
   

  

* Test Architecture for system\-level products across hardware, firmware, and cloud/mobile.
* Automation frameworks (Python, JS, Robot/System frameworks), design patterns, reliability engineering mindset.
* CI/CD and release pipelines; artifact versioning; environment orchestration; test data management.


 Domain Knowledge (Critical for SPAN)
   

  

* Power/energy systems, EV, renewables; grid behavior (voltage, frequency, phase, outages).
* Battery systems, inverters, EVSE; protocols CAN, Modbus, MQTT, REST APIs.
* Hands\-on with oscilloscope, power analyzers, grid simulators, and electrical safety practices.


 Tools \& Technologies
   

  

* CI/CD: Buildkite, Jenkins, GitHub Actions; OTA: Mender; Test tools: TestRail, JIRA, Jama; Embedded/Linux (Yocto).


 Nice to Have
   

  

* UL/IEC compliance exposure; grid codes and safety standards; multi\-region power systems experience.


 Key Traits \& Impact
   

  

* Analytical, system\-level thinking; superb debugging; clear communication and stakeholder management.
* Ownership and bias for action; collaborative across US and India teams.
* Impact: higher release confidence, scalable global testing, fewer field defects, faster time\-to\-market.


**Life at SPAN**
 Our
 **Bengaluru** 
 team plays a pivotal role in SPAN’s continued growth and expansion. Together, we’re driving
 **engineering**

 **product development** 
 , and
 **operational excellence** 
 to shape the future of home energy solutions.
   

  

 As part of our team in India, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate closely with our teams in the US and across the globe. This international collaboration fosters innovation, learning, and growth, while helping us achieve our bold mission of electrifying homes and advancing clean energy solutions worldwide.
   

  

 Our in\-office culture offers the chance for dynamic interactions and hands\-on teamwork, making SPAN a truly collaborative environment where every team member’s contribution matters.

***AutoRABIT Profile***








*AutoRABIT is the leader in DevSecOps for SaaS platforms such as Salesforce. Its unique metadata\-aware capability makes Release Management, Version Control, and Backup \& Recovery complete, reliable, and effective. AutoRABIT’s highly scalable framework covers the entire DevSecOps cycle, which makes it the favourite platform for companies, especially large ones who require enterprise strength and robustness in their deployment environment. AutoRABIT increases the productivity and confidence of developers which makes it a critical tool for development teams, especially large ones with complex applications. AutoRABIT has institutional funding and is well positioned for growth. Headquartered in the CA, USA and with customers worldwide, AutoRABIT is a place for bringing your creativity to the most demanding SaaS marketplace.*


***Job Role***







 The Senior SDET is responsible for manual testing, automation testing and performance testing. This includes creating Test Automation Framework (TAF) suitable for project needs and creating automation test scripts for both API and UI levels of automation. Also, prepare JMeter scripts for the load testing and execute performance tests. This role comes with a lot of excitement and responsibility to train and mentor other test engineers.
   

  








***Roles \& Responsibilities***







* Build the end\-to\-end suite using Selenium/Playwright. Set up the project, page objects and fixtures, and record the critical journeys: login and SSO, tenant onboarding, application registration, running a scan, reviewing issues, configuring rules and profiles, dashboards and reports, notifications, and platform\-tenant administration.
* Keep it green. Own the suite as the product changes. Triage failures quickly, fix flaky tests, and make failures actionable for the developers.
* Test the GraphQL API directly. Write API\-level tests for queries, mutations and auth directives.
* Add unit tests. Write Jest tests for API services using the existing scenario\-fixture pattern, and introduce React Testing Library tests for front\-end components, starting where the risk is highest.
* Test tenant isolation. Design and automate checks that one tenant can never see or affect another's data, through the UI and the API, including background jobs.

title: Senior Quality Engineer, Automation & API Testing
description:
LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open\-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open\-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.
   

  

 LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.
   

  

 OUR PEOPLE:
   

  

 People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.
   

  

 We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The Senior Quality Engineer is responsible for driving quality across the software development lifecycle through a strong focus on test automation, API validation, quality engineering practices, and continuous delivery. This role partners closely with Engineering, Product, Architecture, and DevOps teams to establish testing strategies, improve automation coverage, identify quality risks early, and enable rapid, reliable releases.
   

  

 The Senior QE serves as a quality advocate and technical leader, helping teams adopt scalable automation frameworks, shift\-left testing practices, and data\-driven quality standards. The role is expected to operate independently, influence engineering decisions, and mentor team members on quality engineering best practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Strategy \& Test Leadership**
* Define and execute comprehensive quality strategies aligned with product and engineering objectives.
* Lead test planning activities and establish risk\-based testing approaches across initiatives.
* Review requirements, architectures, and designs to identify quality risks and testability concerns early.
* Establish quality gates, standards, and automation objectives for development teams.
* Provide technical leadership on quality engineering practices across multiple products or services.
* Mentor Quality Engineers and development teams on automation, testing methodologies, and quality best practices.


**API \& Service\-Level Testing**
* Design, develop, and maintain robust API and service\-level automation frameworks.
* Validate REST, GraphQL, and microservice\-based architectures through automated testing.
* Create automated tests covering functional, integration, contract, regression, and negative testing scenarios.
* Validate authentication, authorization, data integrity, error handling, and security controls across services.
* Perform data validation through API responses, databases, queues, and downstream integrations.
* Collaborate with developers to improve API testability and observability.


**Test Automation Engineering**
* Design and maintain scalable automation frameworks for UI, API, integration, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Develop reusable automation libraries, utilities, and test data management solutions.
* Drive automation\-first testing approaches, minimizing reliance on manual regression testing.
* Continuously improve automation reliability, execution speed, and maintainability.
* Measure automation effectiveness using coverage, execution, defect detection, and quality metrics.
* Ensure automated tests are integrated into CI/CD pipelines and support continuous delivery goals.


**System Integration \& End\-to\-End Testing**
* Validate complex workflows across distributed systems, microservices, and third\-party integrations.
* Design test strategies for highly integrated cloud\-based applications.
* Conduct integration and system testing to ensure end\-to\-end business process validation.
* Identify risks associated with cross\-system dependencies and recommend mitigation strategies.


**Performance, Reliability \& Security Testing**
* Define and execute performance, scalability, and reliability testing approaches.
* Analyze application behaviour under load and identify performance bottlenecks.
* Support security testing initiatives by validating authentication, authorization, and API security controls.
* Collaborate with Engineering teams to improve application resilience and production readiness.


**DevOps \& Continuous Quality**
* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms.
* Ensure quality gates are embedded within deployment pipelines.
* Leverage test execution analytics and quality metrics to drive continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams to improve environment stability, test data availability, and deployment validation.
* Support quality practices within cloud\-native and containerized environments.


**Release Quality \& Production Support**
* Evaluate release readiness using risk assessments, automation results, and quality metrics.
* Participate in production incident investigations and root cause analysis.
* Develop monitoring and validation strategies to ensure quality after deployment.
* Analyze defect trends and recommend preventative quality improvements.


**Required**
**Skills \& Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, Software Testing, or Test Automation.
* Strong experience designing and implementing test automation frameworks.
* Advanced experience in API testing and automation using tools such as Postman, Rest Assured, Playwright, Karate, or similar frameworks.
* Strong programming/scripting experience with languages such as Java, C\#, TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python.
* Experience testing distributed systems, microservices, and cloud\-native applications.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, SDLC, Agile, and DevOps methodologies.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates.
* Experience with SQL and database validation techniques.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root\-cause analysis skills.
* Ability to independently drive quality initiatives and influence engineering teams.


**Preferred**
* Experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud environments.
* Experience with containerized platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience implementing contract testing and service virtualization.
* Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or k6\.
* Experience with observability and monitoring platforms (Application Insights, Datadog, Splunk, Grafana).
* Experience in regulated, enterprise, or high\-availability environments.
* ISTQB Advanced, CSTE, or equivalent certification.

title: GTM Automation Engineer
description:
**About Solwer** 




 Solwer is DENSO's technology venture in India, building the digital infrastructure for India's automotive aftermarket. Our products — vehicle inspection (VDI), aftermarket super app, transport and warehouse management (TWM), and fleet management — are live with Toyota Kirloskar Motor, TFS, Uber Black, and 150\+ dealers. We are building the systems that let us scale without scaling headcount.
 



  





**What This Role Is** 




 We are hiring an engineer to automate Solwer's go\-to\-market engine. Today, our dealer acquisition, content production, lead qualification, and inspection report generation are largely manual. Your job is to change that — using LLMs, agents, APIs, and workflow automation to build systems that handle the repetitive, time\-consuming, and data\-heavy parts of our GTM process, so the sales team spends time closing deals rather than doing research and outreach.
 



  





 This is a builder role. You will write code, ship tools, and measure whether they work. You will not own sales targets or manage pipelines. You will build the systems that make the sales team more effective.
 



  





**What You Will Build** 




 ● Automated dealer prospecting pipeline — 2,000\+ target dealers enriched with contact info and outreach history
 



 ● WhatsApp outreach automation — personalized sequences for dealer acquisition and car owner engagement via WhatsApp Business API
 



 ● AI inspection report generator — inspector inputs structured checklist → system generates consumer\-friendly vehicle health report in Hindi and English
 



 ● SEO/AEO content engine — 4 articles per week on vehicle inspection, ELV compliance, TWM ROI, auto\-generated and human\-reviewed before publish
 



 ● Pre\-call brief tool — given a prospect name, auto\-generate a 1\-page research brief before every enterprise sales call

 ● CRM integration — WhatsApp conversations auto\-summarized and pushed to deal records
 



 ● Weekly GTM performance report — auto\-generated from CRM data, delivered to leadership every Monday
 



  





**Technical Skills**

 ●       Python — production\-quality code, not just notebooks

 ●       WhatsApp Business API (Meta Cloud API or Twilio)
 



 ●       Web scraping: Playwright, BeautifulSoup, or Scrapy
 



 ●       REST APIs and webhooks — building and integrating them
 



 ●       RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)
 



 ●       Agentic frameworks: Copilot studio/co\-work), LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or equivalent
 



 ●       Relational database: PostgreSQL or equivalent
 



**GOOD TO HAVE** 




 ●       TypeScript / Node.js
 



 ●       Vector databases — Pinecone, Weaviate, or Chroma
 



 ●       Workflow automation tools — n8n or Make
 



 ●       CRM API integration — HubSpot, Zoho, or Salesforce
 



 ●       ONDC API
 



**NOT REQUIRED** 




 ●       Model training — PyTorch, TensorFlow
 



 ●       MLOps or model deployment infrastructure
 



 ●       Computer vision or deep learning
 



 ●       Data science or statistical analysis
 



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 ●       2–4 years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year building AI applications using LLM APIs — shipped and in production, not just experimented
 



 ●       A portfolio of things used by real people, not just demos
 



 ●       Comfortable working in ambiguity: we show you the manual process, you figure out how to automate it
 



 ●       Able to talk to a sales rep, understand their actual workflow, and build something they will use
 



 ●       Cares whether your automation increases qualified leads, not just whether the code runs
 



  





**What This Role Is Not** 




 ●       You will not own sales targets or be measured on revenue
 



 ●       You will not do marketing strategy — you build the engine that executes it
 



 ●       You will not train foundation models or do ML research
 



 ●       You will not manage other engineers in Year 1
 



  





**Reporting** 




 ●       Reports to: Product / Technology Lead
 



 ●       Works closely with: Inside sales team, Marketing, CEO
 



  





**First\-Year Outcomes** 




 ●       WhatsApp agent handling 50%\+ of car owner inspection bookings without human involvement
 



 ●       Content engine producing 4 articles per week, driving measurable organic traffic increase
 



 ●       Dealer prospecting pipeline reducing rep outreach preparation time by 70%
 



 ●       AI inspection report cutting report preparation time by 60%
 



 ●       CRM data quality measurably improved — deal stages current, activity auto\-logged
 



 ●       Weekly GTM report auto\-delivered — zero manual preparation

title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
Your Job
   

  

 As a
 **QA Engineer (Salesforce)** 
 , you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of Salesforce applications across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Marketing Cloud. You will leverage your expertise in functional testing and test automation to validate business\-critical solutions while helping drive quality throughout the software development lifecycle. This role offers an opportunity to work in a fast\-paced Agile environment where continuous learning, innovation, and AI\-enabled testing practices are encouraged.
   

  

 Our Team

The team is focused on building scalable testing practices, increasing automation coverage, and continuously improving software quality through innovation and customer\-centric thinking.

* Validate Salesforce solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Marketing Cloud to ensure business requirements are met with high quality.

* Support automation initiatives by developing and maintaining Playwright\-based automated test suites using TypeScript.

* Establish effective test data management strategies and ensure appropriate Salesforce environment readiness for testing activities.

 We are looking for an early\-career Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to help us build and maintain the automated tests that keep our products reliable. * Use Git for day\-to\-day version control\- branching, pull requests, and responding to code review feedback on your test code.

title: Senior Quality Engineer (SDET - Automation)
description:
**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Senior Quality Engineer (SDET) to join us in Bengaluru.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, automation\-first role for someone who can design, build and improve automated testing across a complex enterprise fintech platform. You will help strengthen test coverage, improve framework reliability and embed quality earlier in the software development lifecycle. Working closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps and Quality Engineering colleagues, you will support resilient releases, faster feedback and a more consistent approach to continuous testing.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design, write and maintain functional test cases based on business requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Translate product and technical requirements into clear, risk\-based test scenarios that support reliable delivery.
* Create and maintain BDD feature files using Cucumber, with well\-structured scenarios written in Gherkin syntax.
* Develop, maintain and improve automated test scripts using Selenium, Playwright or similar automation frameworks.
* Build automation that is readable, maintainable and aligned with existing framework standards.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing, early defect detection and faster delivery feedback.
* Execute functional, regression, integration and edge\-case testing to validate new features, enhancements and fixes.
* Analyse test failures to distinguish between product defects, automation issues, data issues and environment instability.
* Identify, log, track and manage defects in Jira, ensuring issues are clearly documented, reproducible and linked to expected outcomes.
* Partner with developers, product owners, business analysts and DevOps colleagues to clarify requirements and improve testability.
* Contribute to test data preparation, database validation and SQL\-based checks where needed.
* Support API and integration testing where workflows span multiple services or system components.
* Improve test framework design, coding standards, reusable utilities and automation reliability.
* Help reduce flaky tests by improving locators, waits, assertions, data setup and environment assumptions.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and provide practical testing input during refinement, planning, reviews and retrospectives.
* Share knowledge with other quality engineers and contribute to consistent quality engineering practices across the team.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 4\+ years’ experience in software quality engineering, QA automation or a comparable role, ideally within fintech, financial services technology or enterprise software.
* Practical experience designing and maintaining automated tests using Selenium, Playwright or similar automation frameworks.
* Working knowledge of Java, JavaScript, Python or another object\-oriented programming language.
* Experience writing automated tests for web\-based applications in a commercial software environment.
* Strong understanding of software testing fundamentals, including test case design, regression testing, exploratory testing and defect lifecycle management.
* Hands\-on experience with BDD frameworks such as Cucumber and writing feature files using Gherkin syntax.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines or working with automated test execution as part of software delivery.
* Working knowledge of SQL and experience using database validation to support testing activities.
* Familiarity with Jira or similar defect tracking and test management tools.
* Exposure to API, integration or service\-level testing would be useful.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills, with attention to detail and a structured approach to investigating issues.
* Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain defects, risks and test outcomes to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work effectively within Agile teams and contribute to planning, refinement and continuous improvement.
* A practical approach to quality engineering, with the judgement to balance test coverage, delivery timelines and release risk.
* Willingness to improve frameworks, challenge unclear requirements and support better engineering practices across the team.


**Why EquiLend?**
* Be recognised for your contribution through a discretionary annual cash bonus, linked to individual and company performance.
* Work flexibly with up to 100 remote working days per calendar year.
* Take time to recharge with generous annual leave, plus public holidays.
* Access comprehensive health insurance for you and your dependents from your first day.
* Receive personal accident insurance from the start of your employment.
* Connect with colleagues at an annual company\-sponsored team retreat, hosted at a new location each year.
* If relocating from more than 40 miles away, receive hotel accommodation and travel ticket reimbursement.


**About EquiLend**
 EquiLend is a global financial technology firm at the center of the securities finance industry. Since 2001, we have built the infrastructure that financial institutions rely on to trade, manage, and report. This includes products such as our NGT trading platform, Post Trade Suite, DataLend market intelligence, RegTech solutions, and EquiLend Clearing Services.
   

  

 We operate across North America, EMEA, and Asia\-Pacific, working with banks, broker dealers, asset managers, and custodians to bring greater efficiency, transparency, and automation to the securities finance lifecycle. Our teams combine deep market expertise with a focus on building technology that works at scale, under real\-world conditions, for some of the world's most demanding financial institutions.
   

  

 EquiLend is Great Place to Work Certified™ in the U.S., UK, Ireland, and India, and has been recognized as Global Data Provider of the Year and Regulatory Solution of the Year at the Securities Finance Times Industry Excellence Awards 2025\.
   

  

**Diversity \& Inclusion**
 We know that the best solutions come from teams that bring different perspectives, backgrounds, and ways of thinking to the table. At EquiLend, we are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels they belong and aim to reflect this in how we hire, develop, and support our people.
   

  

 We are actively working to ensure our teams are as diverse as the global markets and clients we serve. That means creating an environment where different viewpoints are sought out and where people can do their best work regardless of background.
   

  

 If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to make it happen.

title: SDET - Audio, SSG
description:

They are a pragmatic problem\-solver with high judgment who brings an experienced perspective to balance quality and strategy trade\-offs to meet the needs of Amazon Devices teams. They will bring clarity to complexity, probing assumptions, illuminating pitfalls with data, and fostering shared understanding. They have specialized knowledge analyzing test procedures, inspecting architectures and developing test infrastructure and tools that provide confidence in product quality.

* Understanding how all elements of the system software ecosystem work together and developing QA approaches and tools that fit the overall strategy
* Responsible for development of test strategies and creation of appropriate test harnesses for Audio
* Providing test infrastructure to enable engineering teams to test and own quality of the services.
* Being a stakeholder of the release to ensure defects are fixed per SLA and end customer experience are protected and improved
* Development and Automation of Audio test plans, monitoring and reporting on test execution and quality metrics .
* Coordinating with offshore Quality Service team on test execution and sign\-off


**Basic Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of test automation frameworks and tools building experience
* 4\+ years of non\-internship professional software development testing experience
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C\+\+, or C\# including object\-oriented design
* Strong in Python, data structure and algorithm
* Expertise in Audio test automation and test methodologies
* Familiarity with various software technologies, methodologies and applied software engineering practices/standards such as Object Oriented Design (OOD), cloud software development and embedded software


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Deep hands\-on technical expertise in automation, developing test frameworks, tools and APIs.
* Experience in Linux subsystem and testing.
* Experience in testing of Audio, Security, Machine Learning models.
* Experience in quality assurance for consumer electronics
* A deep understanding of automation testing by leading engineers who can write automation scripts/programs that will aid in automated testing
* Understanding or experience working with AI models and agents

title: Quality Engineering Lead, Enterprise System [T500-29276]
description:
**About A\&F Co:** 




 At ANSR, we operate A\&F Co. Bengaluru, a hub of digital transformation delivering services exclusively to our client, Abercrombie \& Fitch Co. (A\&F Co.). A\&F Co. is a global, digitally led omnichannel specialty retailer of apparel and accessories catering to kids through millennials with assortments curated for their specific lifestyle needs.
 



 Now is your opportunity to join us and develop dynamic tech solutions to meet the needs of A\&F Co.’s rapidly growing global business. For over 20 years now, companies cutting across size, industry and markets have relied on our expertise to successfully build global business and technology teams. We can help you land a rewarding career in this dynamic industry.
 



 Here, you’ll be part of a team working on Digital Engineering \& Architecture, Data \& Analytics and Digital Operations to build inclusive experiences and outstanding products. Ready to usher in a digital revolution? Apply today.
 



 Disclaimer: Candidates will initially be employed under ANSR and subsequently transitioned to A\&F Co. Bengaluru.
 



  





**Quality Engineering Lead \- Enterprise Systems E2E Team** 




**About the Role:** 




**We seek a Quality Engineering Lead (QE Lead) to lead quality strategy and execution across our ERP and Product\-Facing Enterprise Systems, including Merchandising, Planning,** 
 Forecasting, Product Creation, and Inventory platforms. These systems underpin how products are created, planned, sourced, allocated, and delivered enterprise\-wide. As a Quality Engineering Lead, you ensure these integrated, data\-intensive
 



 systems remain accurate, reliable, scalable, and audit\-ready—enabling teams to respond swiftly to business changes.
 



  





 You will collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Business partners to embed quality into the
 **development lifecycle. Instead of late\-stage testing, you will implement automation\-first, shift\-left quality practices that validate business logic, data flows, integrations, and end\-to\-end** 
 workflows throughout delivery. This role suits engineers who enjoy complex system landscapes, understanding end\-to\-end business processes, and owning quality in enterprise\-scale platforms.
 



  





**What You’ll Do:** 




**Quality Strategy \& Execution and Operational Assistance:** 



* Develop test strategies for ERP and product\-facing enterprise systems aligned with business workflows and operational risk.
* Design and execute tests for end\-to\-end processes across Merchandising, Planning, Product Creation, Inventory, and B2B.
* Validate complex business logic, calculations, rules engines, and configuration\-driven behavior.
* Ensure strong functional and data coverage for system integrations, batch jobs, APIs, and event\-driven workflows.
* Maintain quality standards for functional accuracy, data integrity, and system reliability.
* Provide Operational assistance during GHO off\-hours and report any callouts to Onshore counterparts.



  





**Automation \& Engineering Excellence:** 



* Build and maintain automated tests for APIs, services, and enterprise workflows.
* Drive automation\-first testing approaches for enterprise systems.
* Integrate automated tests and quality checks into CI/CD pipelines.
* Develop reusable test utilities, data validation scripts, and test assets.
* Analyze root causes of defects related to data issues, processing errors, or integration failures.



  





**Data \& Integration Validation:** 



* Validate data pipelines, batch processing, and downstream system impacts.
* Ensure accuracy of planning, forecasting, inventory, and financial data flows.



  





**Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 



* Collaborate with Engineering and Product teams to embed quality early in requirements, design, and refinement.
* Work with Business stakeholders to understand workflows and validate outcomes.
* Communicate risks, defects, and quality insights clearly and proactively.
* Support release readiness and post\-release validation.



  





**Continuous Improvement:** 



* Identify opportunities to improve test coverage, automation reliability, and execution efficiency.
* Suggest improvements for tooling, frameworks, and quality practices across enterprise systems.
* Build domain knowledge of enterprise platforms and business processes continuously.



  





**What You Bring:** 



* 8\-9 years of experience in Quality Engineering, Test Engineering, or Software Engineering.
* Experience testing ERP or large\-scale enterprise systems supporting core business operations.
* Strong understanding of testing complex business workflows and data\-driven systems.
* Hands\-on experience with API testing and service\-level automation.
* Proficiency in JavaScript, Python, or similar languages for test and validation automation.
* Experience validating batch processing, integrations, and data pipelines.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution.
* Comfortable working in Agile or hybrid delivery models.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to reason about complex system interactions.



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Experience with Merchandising, Planning, Forecasting, PLM, Inventory, or Pricing.
* Familiarity with ERP platforms or enterprise SaaS solutions.
* Experience testing complex calculations, optimization logic, or rules\-driven systems.
* Exposure to monitoring, logging, or observability tools in enterprise environments.



  





**Why This Role Matters:** 




 Enterprise Systems drive business decisions—from product creation to inventory planning and supply chain management. Quality issues in these platforms can cause significant operational and financial impact.
 



 As a Quality Engineering Lead, you protect system integrity by ensuring correctness, reliability, and confidence in every release. By strengthening automation, data validation, and developer\- owned quality practices, you enable teams to move faster while safeguarding the business core.
 



  





**Benefits \& Perks:**

title: DFT Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 We are at a pivotal moment where technology is rapidly evolving, and we have some exciting opportunities within our MCU organization that place us right at the center of this transformation.
   

  

 Our current work is focused on developing solutions for high\-growth markets such as AI\-driven data centers and emerging domains like humanoid systems. These areas are shaping the future of computing, automation, and intelligent systems, and offer a unique chance to work on cutting\-edge technologies with real\-world impact.
   

  

 If you are passionate about solving complex technical challenges and want to contribute to innovations in these fast\-growing segments, I encourage you to come forward and apply. This is an opportunity to be part of a journey that is not only technically rewarding but also strategically significant.
   

  

 Looking forward to seeing many of you take this step.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Texas Instruments is seeking a talented and passionate DFT Engineer to join our silicon design team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the testability and quality of TI's next\-generation semiconductor devices. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams spanning design, physical design, and product engineering to deliver high\-quality, silicon\-proven test solutions.
   

  

 This is an exciting opportunity to work on low cost MCUs using industry\-leading EDA tools in a collaborative and innovation\-driven environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and execute DFT architecture and scan insertion strategies for low cost MCUs
* Implement and validate ATPG test patterns to achieve automotive grade fault coverage
* Design and deploy Memory BIST (MBIST) solutions for embedded memories across SoC designs
* Ensure DFT rule compliance throughout the design flow from RTL to tape\-out
* Debug and resolve complex ATPG, scan, and Gate\-Level Simulation (GLS) violations
* Perform DFT sign\-off checks and ensure test coverage meets product quality targets
* Develop and maintain Tcl, Perl, and Python scripts to automate DFT flows and improve efficiency
* Continuously improve DFT methodologies, flows, and best practices within the team


**Qualification**
* Experience with scan compression techniques (e.g., Modus EDT/IJTAG)
* Familiarity with IEEE 1149\.1 (JTAG) / IEEE 1500 standards
* Exposure to low\-power DFT methodologies (clock gating, power domain testing)


**About Us**
